notes.title: 1st August Patch
notes.content:
The Solitaire Knights update is live! Enjoy smoother and more pleasant animation, more reliable card dragging, manual quality controls and higher quality textures.

Our next long-awaited update will restore achievements, add a community leader board and daily community challenges. Look for it soon!

Onward!

notes.title: Join us on Discord
notes.content:
The next bug release will be ready soon. In the meantime, join us on Discord and tell us how much time you've spent in the game when you should be working.

Solitaire Knights Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Q2eQAZu]https://discord.gg/Q2eQAZu[/url]

notes.title: Thanks to everyone who has played the game!
notes.content:
You guys are the greatest and the reason why I make games!

Don't forget that you can also find Solitaire Knights on Google Play and the Apple App Store, also free and with no ads.

There's a couple of issues in this first release of the game that I'm looking to fix ASAP with achievements and card interactions, so look forward to that update soon.

notes.title: Solitaire Knights is coming very soon!
notes.content:
Launch date is almost here and we are excited! We can't wait to see productivity decline across the corporate world, DMVs, call centers and classrooms.

Check back on April the 5th to get Solitaire Knights for free and start wasting time!
